english: The most complete of believers in faith is the one with the best character.

arabic: الْبُخْلُ عَارٌ، وَالْجُبْنُ مَنْقَصَةٌ، وَالْفَقْرُ يُخْرِسُ الْفَطِنَ عَنْ حُجَّتِهِ
english: Greed is a permanent badge of dishonor; fear is a defect; poverty often mutes the tongue of a clever man from arguing his case.

arabic: الصَّبْرُ صَبْرَانِ: صَبْرٌ عَلَى مَا تَكْرَهُ، وَصَبْرٌ عَمَّا تُحِبُّ
english: Patience is of two kinds: patience over what pains you, and patience against what you covet.
The best wealth is the abandonment of desires.
A man's worth is what he does well.
The best deed of my nation is to wait for the reappearance (of Imam Mahdi).
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 52, p. 122

arabic: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ زَكَاةٌ وَزَكَاةُ الْأَبْدَانِ الصِّيَامُ
english: Everything has a tax, and the tax of the body is fasting.
source: Imam al-Sadiq (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 93, p. 248

arabic: لَا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لَا حَيَاءَ لَهُ
english: He who has no modesty has no faith.
source: Imam al-Baqir (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 78, p. 309

arabic: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الصَّلَاةُ فِي وَقْتِهَا
english: The most beloved of deeds to Allah is the prayer at its proper time.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 82, p. 204

english: Knowledge is a treasure and its keys are questions.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 1, p. 198

arabic: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ فَقَدْ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ
english: He who knows himself knows his Lord.

arabic: الْعِلْمُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَالِ، الْعِلْمُ يَحْرُسُكَ وَأَنْتَ تَحْرُسُ الْمَالَ
english: Knowledge is better than wealth. Knowledge guards you, while you have to guard wealth.

arabic: إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُلُوبَ تَمَلُّ كَمَا تَمَلُّ الْأَبْدَانُ، فَابْتَغُوا لَهَا طَرَائِفَ الْحِكَمِ
english: These hearts get tired just as bodies get tired; so seek for them beautiful wise sayings.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَاعِظٌ، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَافِظٌ
english: He who has a preacher within himself has a protector from Allah.
source: Imam al-Sajjad (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 78, p. 141

english: Scholars remain as long as time remains.
